events.title: ⚓Play the Blue Water Builders Demo during Next Fest! 🚢
events.summary: Starting today, you can play the Blue Water Builders Demo as part of Steam Next Fest! Take over your grandfather's abandoned shipyard and begin your journey into the golden age of shipbuilding. Design and construct ships, manage your workforce, handle contracts, and turn a small shipyard into a thriving shipbuilding operation!
